summary:

Red cause: no step branch for the two rows (tests/scenarios/design_model_check_problems.py:147) and code lacks awaiting-answer on capability-proposal and withdrawn on request (scripts/model_work.py:11, :14).
Probes (run): awaiting-answer proposal and withdrawn request each give a file problem today; drafted, withdrawn proposal, refused and open requests do not.
No existing test asserts the old behaviour (search); tests-of had no map, so all test lists are by search.
File problems-step module is at 300 lines: new branches need a new module.
Reading-dependent, both readings in notes: a kept withdrawn request blocks done (v_d1); a missing requirement accepted by a work-item is a file problem, not unresolved.
questions: Should a withdrawn kept request block an initiative's done (v_d1, workqueue_done.py), as a refused one does today? Reading A: r114 literal, as designed. Reading B: withdrawn should close.
Should a work-item accepting a requirement its capability does not have be a file problem (r27 literal) or an unresolved reference?
